description: This file defines the 'ConnectionConflictException' class, a custom exception used within the connectivity commands of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically indicating a conflict with an existing connection that is not available at the moment.

classes.name: ConnectionConflictException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating a conflict with a connection that exists but is currently not available.

classes.name: ConnectionConflictException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of ConnectionConflictException with a fluent API.

methods.name: ConnectionConflictException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of ConnectionConflictException with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: ConnectionConflictException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object and headers, parsing the message from JSON.

methods.name: ConnectionConflictException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
